# lookalike-expired

Synthetic: the request was recorded on 2026-06-01, so its look-alikes expired
90 days later (2026-08-30), before the relist (an exact copy of row 0 under `9000000000000003`)
arrives. The relist shows; the named listing stays hidden by its hash, which never expires. Entries
are kept, not deleted (the card: "It deletes nothing").
